reviewWhy: ServiceNow should follow EPO by itself: listed for a review of the sync
title: EPO change not in ServiceNow (not service mapped)
cardHint: CIs that should follow EPO by themselves but differ from it: the sync did not bring the change. A list to look at.
cardText: CIs that are not service mapped: ServiceNow must follow EPO by itself, so a difference means the sync did not bring the change. Status, name, the three people and the description are compared (the description by letters and digits only). Check a few of them in EPO and in ServiceNow. A change made in EPO less than two days before the report waits: the sync may still bring it. After two days, raise one incident for the pattern with the ServiceNow development team, and keep its number on the cases.
